packageRules.description: Every minor, patch and digest update in one pull request a week.

go-amqp 1.5.1 on reports a link the broker refuses to attach: azservicebus opens a $management link with every sender, which floci-az's broker (the azure-servicebus pack's integration test) has no address for on a topic, so sending to a topic fails. azservicebus 1.11 needs go-amqp 1.7.
ML Kit GenAI Prompt 1.0.0-beta5 is built with Kotlin 2.4, which the models-android probe's AGP 9.4.1 (its built-in Kotlin 2.2) cannot read: raise them together, by hand.
@types/vscode is the oldest VS Code the extension supports (engines.vscode in ide/vscode/package.json): vsce refuses newer types. Raise both together, by hand.

The models-core pack's Python runtimes are compiled with uv pip compile (each file's header gives the command), from their requirements.in: a bump of one line cannot resolve (executorch pins mpmath==1.3.0, say). Recompile them together, by hand. piper-tts stays at 1.2.0, the MIT release (1.3.0 on is GPL-3.0).

customManagers.description: WireMock in the axx-wiremock image. WIREMOCK_SHA256 needs a manual update; the image build fails until it matches.
The Lighthouse the web-lighthouse pack names; npm/package.json and its lockfile pin the same one. It must suit the Chromium of the Playwright the web pack drives: a person checks before it merges.
The Delve axx builds for --debug-steps. It must support the Go release axx is built with.
